name: Alpsws Flipbook for WooCommerce
author: alpsws

sections.description:
Alpsws Flipbook for WooCommerce helps transform ordinary product galleries into interactive digital experiences. Create online catalogs, brochures, lookbooks, magazines, portfolios, and product presentations with realistic page-turning effects.

Instead of displaying static product images, you can showcase products using an interactive page-flipping experience that works across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Perfect for:

  • Product catalogs
  • Digital magazines
  • Brochures
  • Lookbooks
  • Manuals
  • Marketing materials

Key Benefits:

  • Interactive page-turning effect
  • Responsive viewer for all devices
  • Modal popup preview
  • Inline flipbook embedding
  • WooCommerce product integration
  • Gutenberg block support
  • Easy image-based page management
  • Theme template override support
  • Developer-friendly action hooks

Why Use Alpsws Flipbook?

Traditional product galleries often fail to showcase catalogs and brochures effectively. Alpsws Flipbook for WooCommerce provides an engaging page-flipping experience that improves product presentation and helps customers browse content naturally across desktop and mobile devices.

Useful Links

PRO Version: https://alpsws.co.in/product/alpsws-flipbook-for-woocommerce/
Documentation: https://alpsws.co.in/docs
Live Demo: https://demo.alpsws.co.in/
Support: https://alpsws.co.in/contact/

Features

  • Image-based flipbook pages
  • Responsive magazine-style viewer
  • Modal preview on single product pages
  • Gutenberg block support
  • Shortcode support
  • Inline embed functionality
  • Customizable viewer settings
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Theme template override support
  • Developer hooks for extensions

Product Setup

  1. Edit a WooCommerce product.
  2. Enable Magazine Flipbook.
  3. Add flipbook pages using the page builder.
  4. Save or update the product.
  5. Preview the flipbook on the product page.

Shortcodes

Display a modal flipbook button:

[alpsws_flipbook id="123"]

Display an embedded flipbook:

[alpsws_flipbook_embed id="123" width="900" height="600"]<h3>Gutenberg Block</h3>

Search for:

Alpsws Flipbook

inside the WordPress block editor and insert the flipbook directly into any page or post.

Developer Hooks

Product builder extension:

do_action( 'alpsws_product_builder_panels', $product_id );

do_action( 'alpsws_save_product_builder', $product_id, $admin );
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce → Magazine Flipbook.
  5. Configure your preferred settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I create multiple flipbooks?

Yes. Each WooCommerce product can have its own flipbook configuration.

Is the flipbook mobile friendly?

Yes. The viewer is fully responsive and works on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I override templates in my theme?

Yes. Templates can be overridden within your active theme.

Does the plugin support Gutenberg?

Yes. A Gutenberg block is included for easy flipbook insertion.

Can I use PDF files?

The flipbook is currently image-based. Convert PDF pages to images before adding them to the flipbook.
